note: The engine now reads Plaits' shared chord table, so these A/B cases isolate the inherited WAVE path on a chord both implementations can express exactly: Braids COLOR p2=0.71875 parks on its {4, 7, 12} row, while engine HARMONICS=1 selects Original's Major [0, 400, 700, 1200]. Fan is zero and Spread reproduces the table at noon. Chord selection itself is covered by ChordBank and the website runtime-table test, not compared against Braids' private list here. The p1 values are deliberate -- int(p1 * 32767) >> 10 picks a slot on the 33-wave scan line and the low bits crossfade it with its successor, so p1 = 0.6876 and p1 = 0.968902 sit almost exactly ON a slot while p1 = 0.70 sits between two. 16 of the 33 slots have an exact counterpart in Plaits' wave bank and 17 are substituted (see the engine header), so the cases measure both. wave-gain-step parks p1 midway between slots 10 and 11, the widest step in the port's gain table and a pair whose waves are both exact matches.
